blocks.text: Our commitment to ethical innovation, privacy leadership, and sustainable excellence has been recognized by renowned industry authorities and global institutions. Below is a selection of our most meaningful accolades and recognitions.

rows: Red Dot Product Design Award – Winner
Honored for exceptional product design harmonizing ergonomics, aesthetics, and sustainability.
Awarded for transparent supply chain, fair labor, and industry-leading privacy standards.
Recognized for world-class device encryption and hardware-embedded privacy on all Velvera devices.
Cited for carbon-neutral manufacturing, recyclable packaging, and take-back/e-waste programs.
Honored for minimalist interface and seamless AI integration enhancing productivity and accessibility.
Awarded for pioneering secure boot architecture and device management for enterprise clients.

blocks.text:
Red Dot Product Design Award (2025) – Velvera One Pro
Velvera’s signature flagship earned one of the world’s most prestigious design distinctions for its synthesis of durable materials, tactile comfort, and timeless visual identity.

Global 100 Most Ethical Companies (2025) – Ethisphere Institute
Recognized among the world’s most principled companies for unwavering commitment to transparency, privacy, and social responsibility throughout the organization.

Privacy Innovation Award – European Data Protection Authority (2024)
Commending Velvera for industry-first hardware-based encryption and privacy protocols, setting a new benchmark for consumer device security in the EU.

Gold EcoVadis Certification (2025)
Awarded to Velvera for leading environmental performance, responsible sourcing, and carbon footprint minimization—ranking in the global top tier for sustainable operations.

IF Design Award – Velvera Nexus 1 Pro (2025)
Celebrating excellence in user interface and AI-driven productivity, reinforcing Velvera’s leadership in functional minimalism and accessibility.

Editor’s Choice – TechRadar Global Awards (2025)
Velvera One Ultra named the premium smartphone of the year for balancing uncompromising security with modern features and standout design.
Velvera remains steadfast in advancing the frontiers of ethical technology, delivering award-winning products and practices that define the future of mobile innovation.
